name: public.profiles
description: Perfil personal editable, distinto de identidad Auth y autorización.
rules: CHECK (((length(btrim(full_name)) >= 2) AND (length(btrim(full_name)) <= 120))); FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; PRIMARY KEY (id)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_pkey ON public.profiles USING btree (id)
retention: Conservar comportamiento observado: Auth CASCADE para propietario; FK a consentimiento/directorio restringida; eliminación del objeto Storage es operación separada. Política de conservación clínica futura pendiente.

name: public.dentists
description: Ficha pública del directorio académico; no acredita cuenta profesional.
rules: CHECK ((consultation_price >= (0)::numeric)); CHECK ((currency = 'PEN'::text)); CHECK (is_demo); PRIMARY KEY (id); UNIQUE (slug)
indexes: CREATE INDEX dentists_district_specialty_idx ON public.dentists USING btree (district, specialty); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dentists_pkey ON public.dentists USING btree (id); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dentists_slug_key ON public.dentists USING btree (slug)
retention: Conservar comportamiento observado: Auth CASCADE para propietario; FK a consentimiento/directorio restringida; eliminación del objeto Storage es operación separada. Política de conservación clínica futura pendiente.

name: public.appointment_requests
description: Solicitudes académicas; no son citas confirmadas ni historia clínica.
rules: CHECK (((length(contact_email) <= 254) AND (contact_email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'::text))); CHECK (((length(btrim(contact_name)) >= 2) AND (length(btrim(contact_name)) <= 120))); FOREIGN KEY (dentist_id) REFERENCES dentists(id); CHECK (is_demo); CHECK ((length(message) <= 1000)); PRIMARY KEY (id); CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))); FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE INDEX appointment_requests_dentist_idx ON public.appointment_requests USING btree (dentist_id); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointment_requests_pkey ON public.appointment_requests USING btree (id); CREATE INDEX appointment_requests_user_idx ON public.appointment_requests USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)
retention: Conservar comportamiento observado: Auth CASCADE para propietario; FK a consentimiento/directorio restringida; eliminación del objeto Storage es operación separada. Política de conservación clínica futura pendiente.

name: public.patient_consents
description: Consentimiento exclusivo de almacenamiento académico de fotos.
rules: CHECK (((revoked_at IS NULL) OR (revoked_at >= accepted_at))); CHECK (((length(btrim(consent_text)) >= 20) AND (length(btrim(consent_text)) <= 5000))); PRIMARY KEY (id); CHECK (((length(btrim(policy_version)) >= 1) AND (length(btrim(policy_version)) <= 80))); CHECK ((purpose = 'academic_photo_storage'::text)); FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; UNIQUE (user_id, id)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX patient_consents_pkey ON public.patient_consents USING btree (id); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX patient_consents_user_id_id_key ON public.patient_consents USING btree (user_id, id); CREATE INDEX patient_consents_user_idx ON public.patient_consents USING btree (user_id)
retention: Conservar comportamiento observado: Auth CASCADE para propietario; FK a consentimiento/directorio restringida; eliminación del objeto Storage es operación separada. Política de conservación clínica futura pendiente.

name: public.dental_photos
description: Metadatos de objetos privados, no el binario.
rules: CHECK ((bucket_id = 'dental-photos'::text)); CHECK (((object_path ~~ ((((user_id)::text || '/'::text) || (consent_id)::text) || '/%'::text)) AND (length(split_part(object_path, '/'::text, 3)) > 0))); CHECK ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['image/jpeg'::text, 'image/png'::text, 'image/webp'::text]))); UNIQUE (object_path); CHECK (((length(original_filename) >= 1) AND (length(original_filename) <= 255))); PRIMARY KEY (id); CHECK (((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 8388608))); FOREIGN KEY (user_id, consent_id) REFERENCES patient_consents(user_id, id); FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dental_photos_object_path_key ON public.dental_photos USING btree (object_path); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dental_photos_pkey ON public.dental_photos USING btree (id); CREATE INDEX dental_photos_user_consent_idx ON public.dental_photos USING btree (user_id, consent_id)
retention: Conservar comportamiento observado: Auth CASCADE para propietario; FK a consentimiento/directorio restringida; eliminación del objeto Storage es operación separada. Política de conservación clínica futura pendiente.
